readerAnswers.scope: OpenAI says it temporarily paused new sign-ups and upgrades to ChatGPT Pro $200, also called Pro 20X, on September 10.
readerAnswers.existing: It is not an automatic cancellation: OpenAI says existing Pro $200 subscriptions continue to renew as usual.
readerAnswers.lapse: But if you cancel, finish a downgrade, or a renewal failure ends the plan, OpenAI says you cannot buy Pro $200 again until the pause lifts.
readerAnswers.action: Before you change or cancel Pro $200, read OpenAI’s pause FAQ.

explainBack: A pause controls whether a person can make a new purchase or upgrade. A subscription that is still active is different from one that has ended after a change takes effect.
unseenTransfer: A person considering a first upgrade should check the new-purchase rule; an existing Pro $200 subscriber should separately read the FAQ about an account change that becomes effective.
limitations: Producer review is not independent admission.
No observed human-comprehension evidence is claimed.
